model.kind: none - software contract validation of the frozen control harness (no physics model)
model.instrument: scripts/harness validators + config/control/harness v1 schemas at subject_sha (digests: input_digests.json)

inputs.name: instrument_bundle
inputs.note: sha256/size_bytes of every instrument file (schemas, validators, tools) as raw git blobs at subject_sha

observables.name: self_validation_clean
observables.criterion: все валидации ok:true, warnings пусты, exit 0; check-consistency ok:true exit 0 (сам POS001 валидируется на handoff и фиксируется в handoff-событии)

environment.description: Позитивный контроль: каждый опубликованный run-каталог E0-R1 (кроме самого POS001) и execution-каталог EX-NL2-001-R1 обязаны проходить замороженные валидаторы чисто (ok:true, без warnings, exit 0); check-consistency обязан проходить (state/plan не тронуты)
environment.host: local Windows workstation (DSH harness session), no paid compute

seed_policy.policy: NOT_APPLICABLE - fully deterministic software control, no RNG

stop_conditions: runner or validator technical crash on an intact environment -> RUN_FAILED_TECHNICAL, new run id required for any retry
instrument file drift (sha256 differs from input_digests.json) -> campaign BLOCKED
